1084-4279-7918.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
1084-4279-7918.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
1084-4279-7918.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1722-2034-2324-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-2324-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

141-6798-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-6798-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
141-6798-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1424-3800-4687.notablePrerequisites: Iceberg has at least four counters on it.
1424-3800-4687.description:
Activate Presence of Gond by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Iceberg.
Activate Iceberg as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Iceberg, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1170-5131-6289-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6289-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Voyager Quickwelder.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1636-2681-2872-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-6558-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-6558-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-6558-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7267-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

598-2452-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a Zombie card in hand or in your graveyard.
598-2452-3967.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

500-1777-3191-6913.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Chameleon and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Chameleon dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Chameleon tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Burnt Offering, adding {B}{B}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}{B/R}
Resolve the Chameleon trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1777-3191-6913.notes: You can forego casting Burnt Offering if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

3967-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
3967-6887-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1182-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Stonecoil Serpent from your library.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1084-2744-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2438-3534-7084.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You control another nonland creature.
You control another nonland creature.
You control seven or more lands that have different names.
2438-3534-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-3534-7084.notes: The land you earthbend can be Field of the Dead.

277-5702-5954-6753.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
277-5702-5954-6753.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-5702-5954-6753.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tiller Engine each trigger twice.
Resolve all Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the lands.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2316-4871-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
2316-4871-6753.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins.
When the Goblins die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Warrens ability, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

4067-5672-5709.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
4067-5672-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
4067-5672-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rofellos.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1860-2634-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
1860-2634-5148.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it,  allowing you to cast spells as though they have flash this turn.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

3259-4068--95.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4068--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

586-944-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

413-2452-4484.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
413-2452-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ebondeath, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1308-1651-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1308-1651-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

719-2783-3510.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2783-3510.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Xenograft, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

265-2034-4303-4559.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have a combined mana value of ten or greater.
265-2034-4303-4559.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
When Metlwork Colossus dies, Sly Requisitioner and Slagstone Refinery trigger.
Resolve the Sly Requisitioner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Slagstone Refinery trigger, creating a tapped Powerstone artifact token.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Servo and the Powerstone token, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Repeat.

147-914-2332-3593.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
147-914-2332-3593.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Dockside Extortionist onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Step Through by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Dualcaster Mage onto the battlefield from your han .
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Step Through, targeting Dockside Extortionist and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Step Through, returning Dockside Extortionist and Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1-3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 5.

2102-2186-4580.notablePrerequisites: Mirran Safehouse does not have summoning sickness.
2102-2186-4580.description:
Activate Mirran Safehouse using Faceless Haven's second ability by paying {S}{S}{S}, causing Mirran Safehouse to become a 4/3 creature with all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Mirran Safehouse using Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Mirran Safehouse and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 2.
